intervention: One pre-down MLP coordinate clamped at all unpadded prompt and decode positions. Included checkpoints use the ORIGINAL checkpoint calibration maxima and exactly the same signed targets. BF16-rounded target values, greedy non-thinking generation, no parameter edits.
chat_template_policy: Original checkpoint tokenizer, chat template, generation and runtime configuration; every checkpoint is checked against the same token IDs and model geometry.
screen: Every coordinate at off and +/-4/12, on one shared original-model 64-token continuation. Compare next-token distributions at 0/8/16/32/64 answer tokens; shorter prefixes explicitly retain only valid positions. Per model/layer take 3 early-JS leaders, 3 distinct leaders by positive late-minus-early JS, and 2 seeded random coordinates. Generate the UNION across all checkpoints; maximum 224 shared coordinates.
selection: Fine proxy on 2 shared continuations and 17 doses in all included checkpoints. Common 13-setting discovery ladder. No novelty preference. Validate union of 12 readable and 4 mixed/collapse nominations per checkpoint. Then test union of 6 strongest readable nominations per checkpoint, at both nominated settings.
gate: At least 3/4 change and 3/4 coherence in validation and final review; >=4/8 validation matches, >=8/16 locked-test matches, >=4/8 longer and >=4/8 replication matches; <=2 repetition and <=2 collapse flags across the 32 selected-condition neuron outputs. Independent Sol must support the frozen validation description and meet the same final criteria. Failed quality gates remain measured catalogue observations.
scope: Numerical coordinate coverage is exhaustive for this grid. Prompts, doses and decoding are a finite sample. Cross-checkpoint target values and token prefixes are identical; native activation scales are also recorded. No guarantee that an abliterated coordinate represents the same feature.
review_gap_policy: Two attempts per bundle; exhausted invalid responses remain rejected and recorded. Other reviews continue; missing final reviews cannot pass.
paired_descriptive_analysis: Assess EVERY frozen primary coordinate/dose in all included checkpoints, using 32 matched neuron outputs per setting. Report repetition, collapse, task loss, baseline defects and change/coherence independently of the binary gate; retain counterexamples and reviewer disagreements.
